checks: ten original layouts, three environments, staged four roles and 160 timed enemies
ready cannot advance, deploy or collect
deployment atomically spends once, occupies a tile and sets a type-global deadline
invalid rows, columns, occupied rocks, locked types, enemy occupancy and insufficient budget reject without spend
same-type different tile becomes available after cooldown; different types have independent cooldowns
withdrawal has no refund, preserves cooldown and cannot double-remove
production emits exact sky and device resource amounts at declared intervals
resource ID collection is atomic, unique, capped and not double-claimable
uncollected tokens expire exactly and cannot be reclaimed
weapons target only the same row and never fire behind themselves
swept projectile hits first living target and cannot penetrate into the second
armor applies per hit with minimum one damage; slow refreshes without multiplying
rightmost blocking device is contacted first, receives real damage and is not tunneled
a destroyed blocker frees movement; other rows never receive its contact damage
wave-gap emptiness is not a win; last future spawn must appear
breach takes priority when the final enemy is killed in the same step
doing nothing naturally loses without any test HP/position/wave writes
pause freezes resources, cooldown deadlines, tokens, projectiles, wave time and commands
frame partitions share exactly the same production state
log replay preserves budget, spent cooldowns, HP, bullets, tokens/expiry and exact wave progress
bad/null, unaffordable, duplicate and ended logs are rejected; forged resources are ignored
snapshots are copies and authored levels stay untouched
fixture: Explicit edge tests alone alter test-world entities/resources; normal strategy and natural failure suites use original production parameters and normal commands only.
